about: The Translate Toolkit, tools and a Python API for converting and checking translation files.

prs.title: Backslashes no longer double on each CSV round trip
prs.broken: Converting translations to CSV and back doubled every backslash, and doubled it again each time, so changed strings stopped matching and showed as untranslated.
prs.changed: The CSV writer no longer adds an escape character the reader does not expect.
prs.matters: Translators can edit strings in a spreadsheet without breaking them.
